findings.description: Critical: The retained Profile-Aware Setup scenarios are not mapped to executable tasks. spec.md requires the script entrypoint to report local Docker/Podman, ParadeDB health, MCP registration/tool discovery, Railway health/API-key checks, coordination_bridge detection, and missing .secrets.yaml copy guidance (spec.md:9-41), but tasks.md only adds profile-precedence tests and implements `check` against YAML/roster resolution, with its sole listed spec scenario being "Agents file resolved from configuration". A plan-following implementation can ship `check` without the local, railway, or secrets behavior the spec still requires.
findings.resolution: Add failing tests before task 3.6 for Local profile setup, Railway profile setup, and Secrets file missing, then expand task 3.6 to implement those checks/reporting without performing the forbidden mutations. Add a work-package verification step that exercises both profiles with fixture profiles/secrets and asserts the required remediation commands and capability report fields.

findings.description: Critical: The round-1 degraded-report fix is expressible in the schema but not required by any task or gate. spec.md adds scenarios requiring `degraded=true` plus non-empty warnings when any detection layer fails, and `degraded=false` plus empty warnings when every layer succeeds (spec.md:90-99). tasks.md's harness-detection tests cover the four vendor states, roster resolution, and filtering, but never name the degraded or complete-run scenarios; the work-package schema gate validates only one successful `detect-harnesses --json` run with an explicit AGENTS_YAML. An implementation can set `degraded=false` unconditionally and still satisfy the planned tests.
findings.resolution: Add a dedicated failing-test task for `Degraded run is distinguishable from an empty one` and `Complete run asserts completeness`: cover unreadable roster under `--json`, unavailable `vendor_health`/PyYAML at point of use, and any intentionally skipped layer. Update the wp-core JSON validation gate to validate at least one degraded fixture and one complete fixture.

findings.description: Nit: contracts/README.md says `summary.total == len(vendors)` and per-state summary counters are asserted in the test suite because JSON Schema cannot express them, but no task in tasks.md schedules that assertion and V.8 only validates schema shape. A bogus summary can therefore pass the declared contract gate.
findings.resolution: Extend the harness detection tests in task 1.3 to assert summary total and per-state counts, and mention that assertion explicitly in V.8 or the wp-core contract-validation step.

findings.description: The intentional `write_allow` overlap is justified: work-packages.yaml makes wp-integration depend on wp-core, documents the single overlapping file, and explicitly says wp-core must not create `test_skill_md.py`, so the packages are sequential rather than competing parallel writers.
findings.resolution: Keep this decomposition pattern; it is clear enough for both implementers and scope-compliance tooling.
